mgmt_bio.text: Christian Klein, born in 1980, is a German national who holds a diploma in International Business Administration from the University of Cooperative Education in Mannheim, Germany. He started his career at SAP in 1999 as a student and, after various positions including Chief Financial Officer of SAP SuccessFactors and Chief Controlling Officer, was appointed Chief Operating Officer in 2016, a role he held until 2021. He joined the SAP Executive Board in 2018 as head of the Intelligent Enterprise Group, was named co-CEO alongside Jennifer Morgan in October 2019 and became sole CEO in April 2020.
